s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of syncope with exertional fatigue in a patient with a history of heart failure and aortic valve replacement
salient_findings: Syncope without preceding signs or symptoms
Prolonged PR interval and QRS duration on ECG
key_facts: Current medications: warfarin, furosemide, metoprolol succinate, and spironolactone
ECG findings: regular sinus rhythm, prolonged PR interval, prolonged QRS duration
Echocardiogram findings: ejection fraction 28%, akinesia of middle and basal segments of inferior and inferoseptal walls
24-hour Holter monitoring: regular rhythm, mean heart rate 77 beats/min

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of syncope with exertional fatigue in a patient with a history of heart failure and aortic valve replacement
salient_findings: Syncope without preceding signs or symptoms
Prolonged PR interval and QRS duration on ECG
key_facts: Current medications: warfarin, furosemide, metoprolol succinate, and spironolactone
ECG findings: regular sinus rhythm, prolonged PR interval, prolonged QRS duration
Echocardiogram findings: ejection fraction 28%, akinesia of middle and basal segments of inferior and inferoseptal walls
24-hour Holter monitoring: regular rhythm, mean heart rate 77 beats/min

differentials: Cardiomyopathy due to coronary artery disease
per_call: Cardiomyopathy due to coronary artery disease

shortlist.label: High-grade atrioventricular block
shortlist.why_kept: Prolonged PR interval and QRS duration on ECG

shortlist.label: Prosthetic valve thrombosis
shortlist.why_kept: History of aortic valve replacement and prosthetic valve thrombosis complication

shortlist.label: Cardiac conduction disease
shortlist.why_kept: ECG findings of prolonged PR interval and QRS duration, and left axis deviation

shortlist.label: Dilated cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Echocardiogram findings of ejection fraction 28% and diffuse left ventricular hypocontractility

shortlist.label: Cardiac amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: History of heart failure and exertional fatigue, with possible involvement of the conduction system

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG findings, including a prolonged PR interval (240 milliseconds) and prolonged QRS duration (170 milliseconds), are indicative of cardiac conduction disease. Additionally, the patient's history of aortic valve replacement surgery and prosthetic valve thrombosis may have contributed to the development of conduction abnormalities.

rejected.label: High-grade atrioventricular block
rejected.why: While the patient has a prolonged PR interval, the ECG findings do not indicate a complete atrioventricular block.

rejected.label: Prosthetic valve thrombosis
rejected.why: Although the patient has a history of prosthetic valve thrombosis, the current presentation and diagnostic findings do not suggest an acute thrombotic event.

rejected.label: Dilated cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: The patient's echocardiogram findings, including an ejection fraction of 28% and akinesia of certain segments, are more consistent with a history of heart failure rather than dilated cardiomyopathy.

rejected.label: Cardiac amyloidosis
rejected.why: There is no specific evidence in the patient's presentation or diagnostic findings to suggest cardiac amyloidosis.
